descricao: Arara-vermelha 3D de jogo mobile, tirada dos banners da ARARA519 (pasta Arara do Drive, decomposta em 15/10/2026): penas vermelhas, asas amarelas e azuis que fazem de braços, olho grande e bico aberto rindo. Dois figurinos nos banners: rei da selva (coroa de penas e esmeraldas) e turista (chapéu de palha, óculos escuros e camisa havaiana).
prompt: Glossy 3D mobile casino game mascot render, vivid saturated colors, warm golden rim light, confident and charismatic adult character, not a baby, not chibi, not a plush toy. Close waist-up portrait cropped at the waist, filling the frame, no legs, no feet, no floor, no pedestal, no shadow. An anthropomorphic scarlet macaw with adult proportions, a sleek head, bright red feathers, big yellow and blue wings used as arms ending in feathered hands, sharp expressive eyes, large black and white beak wide open in a hyped laugh, leaning towards the viewer, {figurino}, {segura}, isolated on a plain light grey studio background, no text, no letters

figurinos.rei: wearing a crown of colorful feathers set with green emeralds, a gold necklace with a big emerald pendant and gold bracelets with emeralds
figurinos.turista: wearing a straw hat with a green band and tropical flowers, dark sunglasses, an open green Hawaiian shirt with white flowers and a thick gold chain

conferencia.nota: infantil = chance pelo CLIP de ser 'fofo para crianças'. Calibrado em 16/10/2026 nas araras dos próprios banners: rei 0,82 a 0,88, turista 0,01 a 0,62; parecido com a folha 0,83 a 0,98. O limite de 0,9 deixa passar a arara original; acima disso reprova.
